nodes.label: Admin role has manage_permissions by default.
Adding a second override after the first must not fail (regression, #142).
Duplicate permissions in a single payload must not fail.
Overrides that match role defaults are not stored.
Admin can access manage_clients endpoint (role default).
Client with manage_clients override can access clients endpoint.
Superuser can access any endpoint regardless of role.
set_user_permissions raises ValueError for non-existent user.
set_user_permissions raises ValueError for unknown permission strings.
clear_user_permissions removes all overrides for a user.
